about: KUMAKIKAI plans, develops and operates apps for iPhone and iPad. Taking notes in class, reading a conversation that is hard to hear, keeping track of benefit codes: we build useful tools around specific moments in everyday life.

Our products span learning, communication support, and everyday records and organisation. We distribute them primarily through the App Store and continue to review and improve their features and usability after release.
founderBio: Yuya Nakamura has experience in software development across embedded systems, business systems and mobile apps. At KUMAKIKAI, Yuya currently plans, develops and operates apps for iPhone and iPad.

Yuya does not limit app development to a particular field. Ideas come from things Yuya finds inconvenient in everyday use or from problems mentioned by people close to Yuya. Yuya turns those ideas into apps when there seems to be a need for them.
